run_compute_scaling_factors: run the compute_scaling_factors function to fit ScaleFactor modules in a FairChem model using training batches
run_fit_cli: run the fit.py CLI module with argparse flags to compute and save scaling factors to a checkpoint file
review_compute_scaling_factors: review the compute_scaling_factors function that fits all or unfitted ScaleFactor modules in computation order
review_train_batch: review the _train_batch helper that performs a forward pass and loss computation without gradients
refactor_compute_scaling_factors: refactor the compute_scaling_factors function to support non-interactive mode for automated scaling factor fitting
